props.text:
Why SPY over QQQ for the hedge:

1. Dispersion thesis — Low correlation fuels dispersion; thesis is correlation picks up, so just own the cheapest hedges (which is by far SPY)

2. Korea positioning — Did not want to be a passenger to Korea reversal; rather be long it directly

3. Regime analysis — Korea bounce doesn't help SPY much anyway; memory bouncing hurts MAGS and software in this regime
Contextualizes existing SPY averaging thesis + EWY/KOSPI long thesis into coherent multi-asset hedging framework.
